owner_B: Controlled processed-column identifiability, synthetic paired tests, exact/summary descriptor encoding and original admitted development-bank provider
owner_C: research/paper_c_device_admission/, Issue521; official instrument/version/header/public training-byte intake; not modified or executed here

descriptor.source_namespace: Hash-pinned published bank or synthetic position catalog; includes source/version and processing identity
descriptor.master_count: Original column count of this published processed cube; integer 2..436
descriptor.positions: Nonempty strictly increasing unique zero-based integers within master_count, synchronized with actual sliced column order
descriptor.physical_metadata: Separate BandMetadata. Approximate wavelength/FWHM/GSD remains missing to verified-only physical conditioning
descriptor.mapping_guard: IndexPacket.original_physical_mapping_authenticated must remain false in this B bridge; a processed column identity is not an instrument native/SRF coordinate
descriptor.roles: devtrain/devval from original bank; no confirmation/query expansion
descriptor.binding: Observation hash, canonical catalog, donor, missing mask, released-point identity, exact retained positions and frozen Q/near/wide support are checked independently

representations.summary8: Eight processed-position/count/gap statistics; known exact FP32 collisions
representations.exact_mask: Bounded master-count plus full ordered column-presence vector, then learned 437-to32 projection
representations.balanced_summary: Eight statistics padded to437, common fixed orthogonal rotation and L2 normalization, shared learned437-to32 projection
representations.balanced_exact: Full exact-mask vector with the same rotation, normalization and learned projection
representations.limits: Full discrete mask identifies legal processed column sets. Learned32-dimensional embeddings are only pair-qualified and are not globally injective. Sampling statistics or synthetic masks never certify a new real device.

current_real_admission.rejection: New real position sets or roles rejected before bank payload reads; raw API slicing capability does not grant experimental admission

coordination: C can retain native instrument coordinates and version evidence in its own manifest. Any future mapping into B processed positions must explicitly pin its transformation and role authority; nDSM is not treated as a spectral column. B does not reproduce C/D device inventory or genuine-device qualification.
